acceptance: An advance by the owner with the right expected head succeeds and is recorded with reason and files; a stale expected head, a non-descendant head or a non-owner is refused; an exact retry is idempotent.
A fix advance touching an earlier member's files makes final evidence require that member's current-acceptance evidence; a develop-merge advance is excluded from the member file union.
bind_batch_pr moves the bound head given the expected previous head, invalidates final evidence, is idempotent on retry and refuses a different PR.

context and context_append edits on a prepared member keep its receipt; an acceptance edit, a needs edit, a scope edit, a batch edit, a description edit and a links edit each still invalidate it and its dependents (one test each).
context: Decision gate: start only after todo-db-batch-dispatch-base-overlap-20261101 is done, because advances add to the recorded heads that dispatch bases use. Guardrails: work in joeharris76/todo-db under its own repository rules, on a branch and PR, never directly on main; never patch the vendored wheel in BenchBox; one server stays one worker identity (todo-db ADRs 0003 and 0006); every new refusal fails closed with a gate code and recovery steps; BenchBox line citations refer to the vendored 0.12.0 wheel (_project/scripts/vendor/todo_db-0.12.0-py3-none-any.whl), so re-read todo-db main before editing; tests prove behaviour, never wiring.
description: Implement the lifecycle parts of the batch v2 ADR. Add an owner-only operation that advances the registered integration head with an expected previous head, a reason (fix or develop-merge) and the changed files; the new head must descend from the current one and becomes a valid dispatch base. A fix that touches an earlier member's files marks that member as needing current-acceptance evidence at final; a develop-merge is excluded from member scope and union accounting. Make bind_batch_pr revisable: same repository, PR number and node id; a head change needs the expected previous head and invalidates final evidence; an exact retry is idempotent; a different PR is refused. Stop invalidating receipts on context and context_append edits; every other field edit, including acceptance, needs, scope, description, links and batch, still invalidates transitively.
